label: A power for the actual contingent concreta's joint absence is POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over each of them
paraphrase: OPEN transfer bridge for Pruss's own premise (collective to distributive; analyst formulation): whatever has at w a power for the joint absence of the concrete beings contingent at w (one world lacking them all) has POWER_OVER_ESSE_1 over each concrete being contingent at w. The analogue, for powers, of premise B of C1 (disambiguation 197f0097: what accounts for a totality accounts for each member), and of the global variant's transfer bridge. Not derivable from the collective power as typed (controls: a replacement model has the collective power and none over any actual contingent member's esse; formally because PowerOver is unconstrained, the replacement structure on the thin reading of PowerFor only making that choice admissible; that model has one actual contingent, so collective and distributive coincide there, and the separation shown is PowerFor to POWER_OVER_ESSE_1, already for one member; a two-member model separates collective from distributive at the level of PowerFor). ST I q.104 a.3 ad 1 shows the absence is never the holder's direct effect, so the transfer needs a stated bridge; it does not support replacement as the Thomist reading, on which an absence is caused only indirectly, by withdrawing a giving.
